description: Full USGS MRDS record for one mineral deposit by its deposit id — commodities with their roles, deposit type and model, development status, operation type, mining method, years of first and last production, discovery method, alternate site names, host rocks, ore and gangue minerals, and the bibliography behind the record. Sourced from USGS MRData.

dep_id.description: MRDS deposit id, e.g. "10186774". Get one from mrdata_search_deposits.

sections.description: Comma-separated sections to keep, e.g. "deposits,commodity,name". Omit for the whole record.

name: mrdata_deposit
title: Mrdata Deposit
